parts.text:
The jacket can be returned or replaced because it is a damaged product. [2] To return a damaged product fulfilled by H&M, go to Your Orders, select the product, click Return/Replace items, choose a reason, and follow the on‑screen instructions. [1] If the jacket was sold by a third‑party seller, you should contact the seller via the Seller Messaging Assistant; if they do not respond within three business days, you can use the H&M A‑to‑z Guarantee. [1] You may need to provide a clear photo of the damaged zipper for verification. [1] The product must be within the return window and marked as returnable on the product detail page. [2]

Sources:
[1] Damaged Or Defective Item (damaged-or-defective-item.pdf, page 2)
[2] Damaged Or Defective Item (damaged-or-defective-item.pdf, page 1)
